{{Short description|British statistics organization (1948–1993)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=January 2024}}

The '''Institute of Statisticians''' was a British [[professional organization]] founded in 1948 to protect the interests of professional [[statistics|statisticians]].<ref name="rss">{{Cite web |url=http://www.rss.org.uk/site/cms/contentCategoryView.asp?category=42 |title=History of the Royal Statistical Society |access-date=12 September 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120106015804/http://rss.org.uk/site/cms/contentCategoryView.asp?category=42 |archive-date=6 January 2012 |url-status=dead }}</ref> It was originally named ''The Association of Incorporated Statisticians Limited'', but this was later changed.<ref>{{usurped|1=[https://web.archive.org/web/20081120085633/http://www.rsscse.org.uk/ts/gtb/contents.html Royal Statistical Society Centre for Statistical Education description]}}</ref> The institute was formed after the [[Royal Economic Society]] prevented a 1947 extension to the [[royal charter]] of the [[Royal Statistical Society]] which would have allowed it to carry out examinations.<ref name="rss" />

The Institute of Statisticians attempted to obtain a royal charter of its own in 1978 and this led to discussions with the [[Royal Statistical Society]] about a possible merger. Talks foundered over disagreement on how to arrange the various membership categories. Within a few years, however, the talks were revisited, and on 1 January 1993, the two organisations merged, becoming simply the ''Royal Statistical Society''.<ref name="rss" />

From 1950 the institute published a [[scientific journal|journal]], first called ''The Incorporated Statistician'' ([[International Standard Serial Number|ISSN]] 14669404) then renamed ''The Statistician'' ({{ISSN|0039-0526}}) in 1962, before being subsumed into the ''[[Journal of the Royal Statistical Society]]'' as ''Series D'' upon the merger in 1993.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://libweb5.princeton.edu/ejournals/search_zd.asp |title=Princeton University library record of the Institute's publishing |access-date=20 November 2005 |archive-date=30 November 2005 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051130040207/http://libweb5.princeton.edu/ejournals/search_zd.asp |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[https://www.jstor.org/journals/00390526.html JSTOR history of the Institute's journal]</ref>
